channel.title: Elmify — Funded Master's Programmes & Scholarships Abroad (Azerbaijan, Europe & UK)
channel.description: Updates on Azerbaijan State Program (Dövlət Proqramı 2022–2028), HTP, and funded European and UK master's programmes (MSc, MA, LLM, MRes — Bachelor's support coming soon) in English, Azerbaijani, and Russian.

item.title: Elmify Launches First in Azerbaijan in English, Azerbaijani, and Russian
item.description: Elmify launches first in Azerbaijan across English (/), Azerbaijani (/az), and Russian (/ru), checking eligibility for Dövlət Proqramı (2022–2028), HTP / Stipendium Hungaricum, Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, Swedish Institute SISGP, Chevening, and NL Scholarship. Master's degrees are live today and Bachelor's support will be done soon.

item.title: How Elmify's Zero-Fabrication Master's Application Pipeline Works
item.description: Every admission and scholarship rule links to the exact sentence on the official university or funder webpage, and academic CVs, motivation letters, and referee briefs are generated strictly from student-confirmed facts.
